aboutPage.metaDescription: QuickTalk Real Estate is a Dubai brokerage. Founder Fahed Mohamed Aladdin, and group offices in the UAE, Türkiye, and Thailand.
aboutPage.intro: QuickTalk Real Estate is a Dubai brokerage — sale, rent, and off-plan — and the UAE house of a group that also works from Montclair Türkiye and Montclair Thailand.
aboutPage.founderBody: More than 30 years in construction, project management, and international real estate. He began in engineering and construction in Saudi Arabia and the wider GCC, in senior roles on infrastructure, residential, hospitality, and institutional work. A Civil Engineer with advanced study in Business Administration, he has directed project management offices and the cost-control, risk, and contract practice that sit behind a sound purchase. The desk reads a building the way a contractor does — construction, developer, infrastructure, and the market it sits in — not only the price per square metre.
aboutPage.quote: Understanding a building is not just about its price per square metre. It is about the quality of construction, the credibility of the developer, the infrastructure surrounding it, and the long-term trajectory of the market it sits in. That is the lens through which we advise every client.
aboutPage.whoBody: QuickTalk Real Estate is the parent desk of an international real estate and investment advisory group across the UAE, Türkiye, and Southeast Asia. Montclair Türkiye and Montclair Thailand are the regional arms. The structure is one partner for more than one market: a home or investment in Dubai, a citizenship-by-investment asset in Türkiye, or an opportunity in Southeast Asia. Work runs from first conversation through to after purchase.
aboutPage.foundationBody: The people at QuickTalk Real Estate and the Montclair arms have advised international clients in Istanbul, Dubai, and the region for nearly a decade. That leadership did not change when the work continued under these names.
aboutPage.entityUaeBody: The UAE desk: property investment, business setup, and Golden Visa consulting across the Emirates.
aboutPage.entityTrBody: The Turkish market, with developer and legal partners in Istanbul and beyond, including citizenship-by-investment.
aboutPage.entityThBody: Southeast Asia, with developer and legal partners, for GCC and European clients looking at lifestyle-led assets.
aboutPage.pillarMarketBody: Decades of GCC construction and real estate work. Markets from the ground up, not only from a sales sheet.
aboutPage.pillarContinuityBody: The core team that has guided investors across Istanbul and Dubai for nearly a decade is the team that still sits at the desk.
aboutPage.pillarServiceBody: Sourcing, legal due diligence, business setup, residency consulting, and post-sale management — one journey, not a hand-off.
aboutPage.commitBody: The work is the outcome for the client, not only the close. Regulations, currencies, and pipelines move. The obligation does not: accurate, honest, usable advice.

servicesResidence.metaDescription: Residence visa in the UAE: employment, investor, family, domestic worker, specialist, and student paths. Documents, process, and typical timing. Speak on Contact.
servicesResidence.intro: A residence permit is the right to live in an emirate for a set term. The path — employment, investment, family, study, or specialised skill — sets the type and the validity.
servicesResidence.about: A residence visa certifies that an expatriate may live in an emirate for a defined period under UAE immigration rules. Status is granted on conditions set by the government: employment, business investment, family sponsorship, education, or specialised skills. Each path sets the visa type and the term. With residence status you can live, work, and use ordinary resident services in the UAE.
servicesResidence.typeEmploymentBody: For people who have employment with a UAE company. The employer is the sponsor and processes the visa.
servicesResidence.typeInvestorBody: For owners and investors who have established or invested in a company in the UAE.
servicesResidence.typeFamilyBody: For dependants — spouse, children, parents — sponsored by a UAE resident who meets the salary and accommodation rules.
servicesResidence.typeDomesticBody: For household staff sponsored by a UAE resident, including maids, drivers, cooks, and nannies.
servicesResidence.typeSpecialistBody: For people with specialised skills, exceptional talent, or expertise the UAE admits on that basis.
servicesResidence.typeStudentBody: For people enrolled in a UAE-accredited institution, typically for the duration of the course.
servicesResidence.docPassport: Valid passport with at least six months’ validity
servicesResidence.docPhotos: Two passport-size photographs to UAE visa specifications
servicesResidence.docEntry: Entry visa copy, if the applicant is already in the UAE
servicesResidence.docSponsor: Sponsor’s legal residency or UAE citizenship proof
servicesResidence.docLicense: Trade licence copy, for business visas
servicesResidence.docFamily: Proof of family ties such as birth or marriage certificates, for family visas
servicesResidence.processIssue: Visa issuance and Emirates ID application

servicesDependent.metaDescription: Dependent visa in the UAE: spouse, children, parents, and parents-in-law. Salary floors, housing, documents, and process. Speak on Contact.
servicesDependent.intro: A resident who meets the salary and housing rules can sponsor family to live in the UAE. Relation documents issued abroad must be attested.
servicesDependent.about: A business owner or employee can sponsor dependants in the UAE if the current salary and housing rules are met, whatever the profession. Spouse, children, parents, and parents-in-law can be brought on that path. Relation and dependency documents not issued in the UAE must be legalised and attested by the UAE consulate in the country of issue, then by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs in the UAE.
servicesDependent.typeSpouseBody: For a legally married husband or wife of a UAE resident. Needs an attested marriage certificate and proof of adequate housing.
servicesDependent.typeChildrenBody: For sons under 18 and unmarried daughters of any age. Adopted children and stepchildren need further documents.
servicesDependent.typeParentBody: For the mother or father of a UAE resident who meets the higher income rule and can show dependency.
servicesDependent.typeInLawBody: For the parents of a spouse. Needs documents that prove the relation and the higher salary floor.
servicesDependent.docSponsor: Sponsor’s passport with a valid residence visa and Emirates ID
servicesDependent.docPassports: Dependent’s passport copies, with at least six months’ validity
servicesDependent.docPhotos: Recent passport-size photographs of each dependent, white background
servicesDependent.docMarriage: Attested marriage certificate, for a spouse visa
servicesDependent.docBirth: Attested birth certificates, for children and parent visas
servicesDependent.docSalary: Proof of minimum salary — payslips or bank statements
servicesDependent.docTenancy: Valid tenancy contract or property title deed
servicesDependent.docUtilities: Recent utility bills to show an active residence
servicesDependent.docMedical: Medical fitness certificate, for dependants over 18
servicesDependent.docInsurance: Health insurance cover for all dependants
servicesDependent.salaryMale: Male expatriates: AED 4,000, or AED 3,000 plus accommodation
servicesDependent.salaryFemale: Female expatriates: AED 10,000, or AED 8,000 plus accommodation
servicesDependent.salaryParents: Sponsoring parents or parents-in-law: AED 20,000 monthly salary
servicesDependent.housingImmediate: At least one bedroom for immediate family (spouse and children)
servicesDependent.housingExtended: At least two bedrooms for extended family (parents or parents-in-law)
servicesDependent.housingUtilities: Proof of active utilities — recent DEWA, SEWA, or ADDC bills
servicesDependent.processBiometric: Biometric data collection, for dependants over 18
servicesDependent.processIssue: Visa issuance and Emirates ID application

servicesRemote.metaDescription: UAE remote work visa: self-sponsored stay up to one year. Salary floor AED 18,365, documents for employees and owners, process. Speak on Contact.
servicesRemote.intro: Self-sponsored stay of up to one year for people who work remotely, with ordinary resident services such as banking and schooling.
servicesRemote.apply: Apply for a remote work visa
servicesRemote.about: The remote work visa lets a foreigner enter the UAE under self-sponsorship and work under the remote-work rules in force. Holders can use ordinary resident services — banking, investment, government desks, and schooling. The published term is up to one year.
servicesRemote.reqGeneralPassport: Passport with at least six months’ validity
servicesRemote.reqGeneralInsurance: Health insurance valid in the UAE
servicesRemote.reqGeneralAddress: Proof of address in the home country
servicesRemote.reqEmployeeContract: Employment contract valid for one year
servicesRemote.reqEmployeeBank: Bank statements for the previous three months
servicesRemote.reqEmployeeLetter: Letter from the current employer confirming a remote-work arrangement
servicesRemote.reqOwnerProof: Proof of company ownership for the last year
servicesRemote.reqOwnerBank: Bank statements for the previous three months
servicesRemote.coverLiveBody: The visa is not tied to one city. You may live where the file allows, including Dubai and the other emirates.
servicesRemote.coverServicesBody: Banking, schooling, and ordinary government services available to residents, subject to current rules.
servicesRemote.coverTaxBody: No personal income tax on foreign-earned income under current UAE rules. Confirm the file; corporate tax is a separate regime.
servicesRemote.coverFamilyBody: Eligible holders may sponsor a spouse and children to join them in the UAE.
servicesRemote.processSubmit: Application submission to the relevant authorities
servicesRemote.processIssue: Emirates ID and residence visa issuance

servicesGolden.metaDescription: UAE Golden Visa: 5- or 10-year renewable residence without a local sponsor. Investors, specialised talent, students. Speak on Contact.
servicesGolden.intro: Five- or ten-year renewable residence without a local sponsor, including 100% foreign-owned businesses where the file allows.
servicesGolden.about: The UAE Golden Visa is a 5- or 10-year renewable residence visa for investors, entrepreneurs, specialised talent, researchers, and students with strong academic records. Holders may live, work, or study in the UAE without a local sponsor, and may own 100% of a mainland business where the file allows. This site’s published property path is AED 2 million for a ten-year visa; other categories follow the lists below. Thresholds move; we confirm them on the file.
servicesGolden.typeTenBody: Long-term residence for major investors, specialised talent, scientists, and researchers with significant work in their field.
servicesGolden.typeFiveBody: Residence for real-estate investors, entrepreneurs, and students with strong academic records.
servicesGolden.reqTenInvestor: Investors with public investments of at least AED 10 million
servicesGolden.reqTenTalent: Specialised talent in science, medicine, art, culture, or other fields
servicesGolden.reqTenScience: Scientists and researchers with significant achievements
servicesGolden.reqTenExec: Executive directors with a bachelor’s degree and five or more years’ experience
servicesGolden.reqTenDoctors: Doctors and specialists in vital fields
servicesGolden.reqTenSchool: High-school graduates with exceptional academic performance
servicesGolden.reqFiveProperty: Real-estate investors with property investments of at least AED 5 million
servicesGolden.reqFiveFounder: Entrepreneurs with an existing project worth AED 500,000 or more
servicesGolden.reqFiveGpa: Outstanding university students with a GPA of 3.75 or higher
servicesGolden.reqFiveUni: Graduates from the top 100 universities worldwide
servicesGolden.reqFiveSchool: High-school graduates with distinction, and their families
servicesGolden.coverTermBody: Five or ten years of renewable residence, so the file is not rebuilt on a short cycle.
servicesGolden.coverFamilyBody: Eligible holders may sponsor a spouse, children, and other dependants the rules allow.
servicesGolden.coverSponsorBody: Live and work in the UAE without a local sponsor or an employer as sponsor.
servicesGolden.coverBusinessBody: Establish and own 100% of a mainland business without a local partner, where the file allows.

servicesFreelance.metaDescription: UAE freelance visa: TECOM GoFreelance permits in media, tech, education, and design. Documents, process, 10–12 working days. Speak on Contact.
servicesFreelance.intro: Independent work under a TECOM GoFreelance permit in media, technology, education, or design, then an employment visa and Emirates ID. Often used by people already on a dependent visa.
servicesFreelance.about: GoFreelance is a TECOM initiative that lets freelancers work as independent contractors in technology, education, media, and design. The permit is often used by professionals already on a dependent visa, who then only need the freelance license. It identifies you as a sole practitioner working in your own name, not a brand, and allows you to work with more than one client.
servicesFreelance.typeMediaBody: Journalism, publishing, film production, photography, and other media work.
servicesFreelance.typeTechBody: IT specialists, software developers, web designers, app creators, and other technology work.
servicesFreelance.typeEducationBody: Tutors, educators, trainers, counsellors, and other educational services.
servicesFreelance.typeDesignBody: Graphic, interior, and fashion designers, and other creative work.
servicesFreelance.docCv: CV showing relevant experience and qualifications
servicesFreelance.docPassport: Passport copy, valid for at least eight months
servicesFreelance.docBank: Bank reference letter confirming good standing
servicesFreelance.docNoc: NOC from the UAE sponsor, if on a dependent visa
servicesFreelance.docEstablishment: Establishment card for the freelance business
servicesFreelance.docPhotos: Passport-sized photographs, as specified for UAE visas
servicesFreelance.coverClientsBody: Work with multiple clients without being tied to a single employer.
servicesFreelance.coverPlaceBody: Work from Dubai, including clients in the wider MENA market, where the file allows.
servicesFreelance.coverLicenseBody: An official license when you deal with clients and companies.
servicesFreelance.coverBankBody: Open corporate accounts and process business payments under the license.
servicesFreelance.processPermit: Application for a freelance permit in the chosen field
servicesFreelance.processMedical: Medical testing and Emirates ID registration

servicesRenewal.metaDescription: UAE trade-license renewal: mainland and free zone, annual. Delays hit operations, visas, and banking. Speak on Contact.
servicesRenewal.intro: Mainland and free-zone licenses renew each year. Delay hits operations, visas, and banking.
servicesRenewal.about: Mainland and free-zone companies must renew the license each year. Delay is costly and can hit operations, visas, and banking. Changes on the license — including a switch of local sponsor — can push the file past the deadline and into fines.
servicesRenewal.coverDocs: Preparation and verification of the file
servicesRenewal.coverPenalties: Avoid late fees and a stop in operations
servicesRenewal.coverOps: Continuous operations after the license is renewed
servicesRenewal.coverComplex: Sponsor changes and other structural changes on the same file
servicesRenewal.coverUpdates: Updates while the file is in process

servicesModification.metaDescription: UAE trade-license modification: name, activity, address, sponsor, management, partners, capital. Speak on Contact.
servicesModification.intro: When the company changes, the license must follow — activity, sponsor, name, address, and the rest of the file — without stopping operations.
servicesModification.about: As the company grows, the license may need to follow: add or remove an activity, change the sponsor or company name, or update the address. The file is applications and supporting documents, then the relevant authorities and portals. Activity should not stop while the amendment is in process.
servicesModification.amendActivity: Addition, change, or withdrawal of a business activity
servicesModification.amendManagement: Change or addition in management details

servicesCancellation.metaDescription: UAE trade-license cancellation: NOCs, visa and labour-card cancellations, clearances. Speak on Contact.
servicesCancellation.intro: Closing a company needs clearances and NOCs. Miss a step and fines follow. Visas and labour cards are cancelled with the license.
servicesCancellation.about: Cancelling a trade license or liquidating a company is a serious step. Some of the file is straightforward; some of it is not — including NOCs from several government entities. An error or an omission can bring fines, which is a poor extra cost when the company is already closing.
servicesCancellation.reqClearance: Clearance from government authorities, to avoid fines
servicesCancellation.reqInform: Notice to the relevant authorities that the company is no longer in business
servicesCancellation.reqLiabilities: Discharge of liabilities to creditors and partners
servicesCancellation.reqReputation: A clean close, so a later license in the UAE is not blocked by the old file

servicesFreezing.metaDescription: UAE trade-license freeze: up to three years, one year for DED sole establishments. Fee AED 2,000 per year plus AED 210 per overdue month. Speak on Contact.
servicesFreezing.intro: A license can be paused — typically up to three years, or one year for a DED sole establishment. Operations must stop while it is frozen. The owner may still open a new license in their own name.
servicesFreezing.about: A trade license can be frozen for up to three years, against a freezing fee. For a sole establishment registered with DED, the pause is one year. Once the license is frozen, the company cannot operate — that is illegal. The owner of a frozen license, or a shareholder, may still apply for a new license in their own name.
servicesFreezing.feeLine: AED 2,000 per year, plus AED 210 for each month due since the license expiry date.
servicesFreezing.processLetter: Issue a formal request letter on corporate letterhead
servicesFreezing.processMohre: Obtain confirmation from the Ministry of Human Resources
servicesFreezing.processInspect: Submit the inspection report and pay the freezing fees

privacyPage.title: Privacy
privacyPage.metaDescription: How Quick Talk Real Estate handles information on this catalog: inquiries, accounts, cookies, and hosting.
privacyPage.intro: How this website handles information. This describes current practice on the catalog — not a certificate, and not a substitute for advice on a file.
privacyPage.whoBody: Quick Talk Real Estate (QTRE) publishes this site. It is a brokerage catalog of sale, rent, and off-plan listings. Reach the desk through the Contact page, or any email or phone published on this site.
privacyPage.inquireBody: A listing or project inquiry stores your name, email, optional phone, and message, together with the listing or project you asked about. That record sits in our database so the desk can follow up; it is not a public page. A visa or license inquiry from Services stores the same contact fields plus the desk you named, in a separate inbox — not with listing inquiries. The general Contact form, when it is published, is hosted by GoHighLevel — what you type there is processed by that form, not stored with listing or service inquiries. A published chat widget is also GoHighLevel; that conversation is not stored with those inquiries.
privacyPage.accountsBody: Admin, agent, and client portal sign-in uses Clerk. You do not need an account to browse the catalog. Portal accounts are for the desk and for the List Your Property path when that portal is live.
privacyPage.cookiesBody: The catalog may save a grid or list view in a cookie. Sign-in sessions use Clerk cookies. The language you choose is on the path (/en, /ar, /tr), not a tracking profile. If a chat widget is published, GoHighLevel may set its own cookies when that widget loads. This site has not connected Google Analytics or advertising pixels.
privacyPage.mapsBody: Some listing pages embed a Google Map when a pin exists. Google may collect data under its own terms when that embed loads.
privacyPage.hostingBody: The site runs on Vercel. Listing data is in Convex. Public listing files are in Vercel Blob. Those providers process what they need to run the site.
privacyPage.keepBody: Inquiry records stay until the desk deletes them in ordinary lead handling. We do not sell mailing lists from this catalog.
privacyPage.requestsBody: To ask what we hold, to correct it, or to ask that an inquiry be removed, use the Contact page or the published email on this site.

termsPage.title: Terms
termsPage.metaDescription: Conditions for using the Quick Talk Real Estate catalog. Listings are published information, not an offer or a contract.
termsPage.intro: Conditions for using this catalog. Reading a listing is not a contract.
termsPage.catalogBody: Listings, prices, availability, and project facts are published as held on our books at the time of publication. They can change. Photographs and descriptions identify a listing; they are not a survey or a title description.
termsPage.offerBody: Nothing on this site is an offer to sell, a prospectus, or investment advice. Off-plan figures, payment plans, and visa notes are published information, not a promise that a file will complete.
termsPage.inquireBody: Sending an inquiry asks us to contact you. It does not reserve a unit, appoint us as your exclusive agent, create a brokerage agreement, or file a visa or license application with the authority.
